$comment: Every entry must state WHY the match is not a secret. An allowlist entry is a
reviewed decision, not a way to make CI green: the value is the reason.
Entries are keyed by rule id, then by repository path (as printed by the scanner).
Do not paste credential-shaped literals into these reasons — this file is itself scanned.
Re-review an entry whenever the listed file changes.

db-connection-string..github/workflows/ci.yml: Disposable CI service container: a local ephemeral GitHub runner PostgreSQL with the well-known default superuser password. No production host, no real credential.
db-connection-string..github/workflows/watchtower.yml: Disposable CI service container: a local ephemeral GitHub runner PostgreSQL with the well-known default superuser password. No production host, no real credential.
db-connection-string.game/docs/DB_RUNBOOK.md: Documentation examples pointing at localhost with placeholder hosts. Reviewed 2026-09-28: no real hostname and no production credential.
db-connection-string.game/scripts/db-roles.ts: Source comment showing the CLI argument shape with an ellipsis placeholder for the password. Not a credential.
db-connection-string.game/tests/db/gameops-unit.test.ts: Loopback test database URL with a throwaway password that exists only for the duration of the test run.
db-connection-string.watchtower/docs/local-postgres-without-d: Documentation example for a local PostgreSQL container. Localhost only; nothing leaves the machine.

rpc-url-credential.game/tests/offchain/security.test.ts: Negative test fixture: the literal token is secret-value and exists to prove the redaction path works.

helius-key-in-url.game/apps/backend/tests/security.test.ts: Negative test fixture for the RPC URL redactor: the key is the literal word SECRET123.
helius-key-in-url.game/apps/web/.env.production: NOT ALLOWLISTED — finding S-01 in docs/PRODUCTION_DEPLOY_CHECKLIST.md. A real Helius devnet API key was committed in commits 55ba9d9..87eb954 and deleted in a later commit. Deletion does not remove it from history. Rotating the Helius key is a human action and MUST happen before any history rewrite.

solana-base58-secret.game/README.md: Solana transaction signature (88 base58 characters) for the devnet redeploy. A signature is public data and is not key material.
